'''Thakira Tatara''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Gender|female]] worked as spiritual [[Horticulturalist|horticulturists]] with her [[Gender|sister]] [[Kiraya Tatara]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Thakira specialized in nutritive [[plant]]s and she and Kiraya traveled from the [[Southern Isles]] to [[Merchant|sell]] their wares in [[Olega City]]. In [[132 BBY]], the sisters spent [[time]] near [[Olega Apothecary]] in the [[city]] and drank together nearby at [[Local day|night]].

==Biography==
Thakira Tatara and her [[Gender|sister]] [[Kiraya Tatara]], both [[humanoid]] females, both worked as spiritual [[Horticulturalist|horticulturist]]s on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Thakira focused on nutritive [[plant]]s, while Kiraya concentrated on medicinal growing in her [[Kiraya Tatara's greenhouse|greenhouse]]. The two sisters traveled from the [[Southern Isles]] to [[Olega City]], [[capital]] of Olega, where they sold exotic [[seed]]s and [[Plant|sprigs]] as [[Merchant|street vendors]] while Kiraya also supplied [[balm]]s and [[oil]]s to local apothecaries and healing houses.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

[[File:TataraSistersDrinking-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Kiraya Tatara and Thakira Tatara sit together, bottles in hand, under an awning in Olega City at night.|The Tatara sisters drank together in Olega City.]]
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Thakira and Kiraya walked together past the [[Olega Apothecary]] in the streets of Olega City as the [[Sith assassin]] entered the apothecary to [[Mae's quest|meet]] her ally [[The Stranger|Qimir]] inside. The two sisters were then stood outside the apothecary at a stall with several other customers when Qimir later returned to the building,. Later that [[Local day|night]], the two horticulturists sat drinking from bottles together under an awning near the apothecary<ref name="RevengeJustice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref> as other merchants packed up their stalls for the night<ref name="RevengeJusticeAD">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> in the streets around them.<ref name="RevengeJustice" />

==Personality and traits==
Thakira had [[Color|ginger]] [[hair]] and light skin with a band of green around her [[eye]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
Thakira and Kiraya wore matching [[Clothing|outfits]] while in Olega City. These included a blue dress, a black-patterned brown shirt, a green [[jacket]], and a matching green hood. Both sisters carried brown handloomed seed satchels.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thakira Tatara appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
